method.candidateDistance: Exact segment-to-segment minimum between building footprint boundary and route polyline, <=100m; not centroid distance.
method.firstRow: Sample route at <=5m spacing, cast left and right normal rays 100m; retain first footprint intersection. Curved corners, longitudinal facades and narrow glimpses can be missed. Candidate inventory retained for review.
method.frontage: Dominant visible footprint edge selected by summed road sample length. This is geometric visibility, not a real-world claim that vegetation/furniture is absent. Adjacent boundary segments aligned within 3 degrees are merged; sourceEdgeIndices retains their indices after duplicate closing point removal.
method.heights: OSM height or levels estimate retained explicitly; never silently promoted to measured height.
method.photoCoverage: Only matched building-specific exterior photos count; district panoramas are context refs, not per-building surveyed evidence.
